author: Krishna 0000
title: Absolutely untrustworthy and poorly managed
review_text: I rarely leave reviews, but my experience with this finance app was so bad, I feel compelled to warn others. Worse than the app, though, are the people running it. I’ve reached out to support multiple times with serious issues affecting my financial data, and the responses I got were either canned messages or completely unhelpful.   I’ve deleted the app and moved to a more reputable service. I strongly suggest you do the same — don’t risk your finances with a company that clearly doesn’t care.

author: Joey Wickham
title: Unable to use as American
review_text: Very frustrating. Tried for over an hour to setup so that I could use for paying certain items, but couldn’t get past the final document page. I uploaded passport, but it would let me select proper expiration date and it asked me to submit back page of passport. Even after putting expiration date as far as I could in future and uploading front of passport twice, it wouldn’t let me get through last step.  I guess I will be either using fonepay or cash where I have to.
